title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 Episode 13
key_events: Choso uses his Blood Manipulation technique on Yuji. Yuji is injured and retreats to a restroom to dilute Choso's blood. Choso pierces Yuji's liver, leading Yuji to go all out in an attempt to kill Choso. However, Choso blocks Yuji's attack with a blood shield. Just as Choso is about to deliver the finishing blow, he is overwhelmed by fabricated memories of Yuji addressing him as his brother, causing him to halt the fight and wander away. The Hasaba sisters find the unconscious Yuji.
content:
Choso pierces through Yuji's left arm with his Blood Manipulation technique.
Struggling to defend himself against Choso's assault, Mechamaru instructs Yuji to retreat into a restroom and flood it to dilute Choso’s blood.
Nonetheless, Choso manages to pierce Yuji's liver.
Believing he is dying, Yuji goes all out to kill Choso, hoping his sacrifice will help the others save Gojo, but Choso uses a blood shield to block Yuji's Divergent Fist.
As Choso is about to kill him, he is suddenly overwhelmed by fabricated memories with Yuji, in which Yuji addresses him as his brother.
Confused, Choso halts the fight and wanders away, while the Hasaba sisters find the unconscious Yuji.
